description: This file defines the EmployeeTerminationService class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides methods for interacting with employee termination data, such as retrieving termination reasons, utilizing a DAO and normalization traits.

classes.name: EmployeeTerminationService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to access employee termination data, including getting termination reasons.

methods.name: getEmployeeTerminationDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmployeeTerminationDao, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonsArray
methods.description: Retrieves and normalizes the list of termination reasons from the DAO.
